independent_findings.finding: Initial independent run had 18 passing tests and one error: changed producer receipt caused an already-reserved, never-launched consumer to retain its capacity slot indefinitely.
independent_findings.resolution: The final dispatcher seals a deferred_prelaunch_integrity result and never_launched release only when the consumer has no launch intent; the regression confirms an unrelated eligible job can use capacity.

independent_findings.finding: A caller crash after writing a never-launched deferral result but before release could strand the reservation because later dispatch skipped jobs with a result.
independent_findings.resolution: Reconciliation revalidates cached deferral/binding state and completes the release only while the attempt remains unlaunched; the added crash-boundary test passes.

independent_findings.finding: Malformed or missing admission records could hide held reservation counts or allow unrelated dispatch past unknown capacity history.
independent_findings.resolution: Unknown reservations are counted conservatively, and an untrusted admission with a retained reservation freezes dispatch; both cases have explicit tests.

remaining_limits: Capacity applies only to cooperating queue clients using the dedicated queue execution substore; direct launches in other executor stores are outside its bound.
Unregistered partial executor preparation fails closed and requires investigation; this is not an adoption or repair path.
The 23 tests use invented subprocess fixtures and validate software lifecycle behavior, not forecasting science or artifact qualification.
final_review.review_conclusion: No material queue integrity or recovery gap found in the reviewed frozen snapshot. Reservation/binding/result/release links are revalidated; dependencies use exact pinned native receipt bytes and explicit SHA arguments; resume requires immutable proof of a sealed, never-launched prelaunch deferral. Queue/process/native metadata never establishes scientific qualification, which remains unassessed.

scope: Independent source/test review of synthetic bounded local DAG queue only; no owner job adoption, scientific fit, qualification, promotion, or deployment.
